'''Recopia''' was a sparsely settled [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], between the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. Lacking natural resources, lawless Recopia had little to offer beyond anonymity for the Core's fringers. However, Recopia was better known as a major trade world, famous for the [[Hinder Market]], one of the largest markets in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] live animal trade. During the annual [[Bandercamp Auctions]], [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] from across the galaxy spent five [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] bidding on rare and exotic creatures.

==Description==
===Planetary position===
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Recopia<ref name="CW" /><ref name="CE" /><ref name="JM" /><ref name="FD" /> had three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and orbited the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Recopi]] in the fourth position. Its [[Recopi system/Legends|Recopi star system]]<ref name="CW" /> was located in the portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] region that was known as the [[Arrowhead]], or Inner Core,<ref name="Region" /> within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="CW" /><ref name="EAOC" /> Situated near<ref name="CE" /> the planet<ref name="CW" /> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the Recopi system lay between the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]],<ref name="CE" /><ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> two of the largest [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroutes]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="EA" />

===Natural features===
====Geography====
Recopia was the only terrestrial planet in its star system with a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climate, a [[Atmosphere/Legends|breathable]] atmosphere, and standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. Its diameter was 14,463 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. One Recopian day lasted 20 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], while a full [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on the planet lasted 286 [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]].<ref name="CW" />

[[File:ScapioInRecopia.jpg|left|thumb|260px|The landscape of Recopia]]
Geographically, Recopia lacked valuable natural resources<ref name="CW" /><ref name="CE" /> and was little more than a world of [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfuric]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]<ref name="CW" /><ref name="CE" /><ref name="FD" /> over which [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] clouds perpetually roiled. The hostile seas were broken only by a series of plateau islands that rose high into the sky – sometimes a kilometer or more – before leveling off. Thousands of these plateaus existed on Recopia, some in tight clusters and others scattered hither and yon over vast tracts of ocean. Many of these plateaus rose above the poisonous levels of fog, making them habitable for those suitably motivated to live on them. Even on safe plateaus, the air reeked of unwholesome organic compounds, but these islands were lashed by frequent monsoons that helped to cleanse the air. Only an eighth or so of the plateaus were populated.<ref name="CW" />

====Native wildlife====
Despite the hostile environment, the wildlife of Recopia featured exotic animals, such as the [[Water/Legends|aquatic]], [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]]-like [[krendel]]s. They were born and raised in Recopia's toxic seas but soon developed [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] and [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. The rubbery, sticky pads on their feet allowed them to climb sheer rock surfaces. These biological advantages enabled them to venture onto land in search of prey, usually [[Seabird/Legends|seabirds]] nesting on island cliffs. Since they could not see particularly well, they hunted primarily by scent and motion. Krendels hunted in mated pairs. Although they generally steered clear of settled areas, krendels occasionally blundered over the cliffs and into communities.<ref name="CW" />

===Inhabitants===
[[File:RaziKhan.jpg|right|thumb|260px|The lawless world of Recopia was a prime gathering place for the Core's fringers]]
The lawless, independent nature of Recopia, coupled with its resistance to nosy outsiders, made it a prime gathering place for the Core's fringers, both those who trafficked in the Core and those whose shady projects took them beyond its confines. Meanwhile, various religious pilgrims, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] fleeing war and disaster, and those seeking a fresh start settled on Recopia. These divided communities gradually grew into [[City-state/Legends|city-states]] as those seeking to escape the bustle of the Core arrived and put down roots. Each city-state had its own government and laws, each according to its nature: some settlements featured [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic-standard]] legal systems, while others enforced their edicts at the point of a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]].<ref name="CW" />

Recopians were hardy and taciturn folk who minded their own affairs. The average citizen showed little interest in traveling beyond the city-state where he was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]]. Although the Recopians' desire to be left alone was less pronounced in the larger city-states with [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], it was nonetheless a nearly universal trait among most people visitors were likely to meet. Travel on Recopia was entirely by air. Even the crudest settlement had at least a rudimentary airfield for [[Skyhopper/Legends|skyhoppers]] and [[Transport/Legends|transports]].<ref name="CW" />

At the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the total population of Recopia was estimated at approximately 200 million [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings,<ref name="CW" /> considerably below the average population of surrounding inhabited star systems.<ref name="EA" /> With 74% of the total population, [[Human/Legends|Humans]] constituted the ethnic majority, but more [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] dwelled on Recopia than on most other Core Worlds settled by Humans. Some city-states were entirely populated by one [[Species/Legends|species]]. For instance, [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] and [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] both maintained large local enclaves.<ref name="CW" />

==History==
The non-descript island of [[Mallif Cove]] on Recopia was once home to a hidden [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] belonging to the [[Seyugi Dervish]]es, an enclave of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].

Recopia was also one of the first Core Worlds to openly support the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] following their victory at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Due to its strategic location, the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]] established a [[Base Delta-Nine|base]] there, from which many early attacks on the Core were launched. It was from their Recopia base that the New Republic attacked [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
